name: hourly-deploy-health
prompt: Check production health. Hit the health endpoint listed in business/knowledge-base/runbook.md (curl, expect 200). Use the vercel-deploys skill to check the latest Vercel deploy state. Use the flyio-status skill to check Fly app status. If everything is green and there have been no incidents in the last hour, respond with exactly '[SILENT]' so Slack stays quiet. Otherwise post a one-paragraph status to #alerts with the failing component and what changed since the last check.
